statement: On compact metric state and action spaces, with a weakly continuous transition kernel and closed reachability goal, every finite Bellman stage is Borel measurable, each action supremum is attained, and an optimal deterministic Borel Markov policy exists.

quantifiers.state_space: X=M_<=W(K) for every compact metric K and finite W>0
quantifiers.kernel: every Borel probability kernel satisfying the stated Feller condition
quantifiers.goal: G={0}, or the displayed closed goal set

proof_obligations: The closed-goal indicator is bounded upper semicontinuous.
Weak kernel continuity plus Portmanteau preserves upper semicontinuity of Q_b.
Compact-action maximization is attained and preserves upper semicontinuity.
The argmax correspondence has a Borel graph and nonempty compact sections.
A Borel measurable selector exists at every stage.
Finite-horizon dynamic programming with those selectors attains V_B^*.
verification_condition: A complete acyclic dependency certificate covers upper-semicontinuity, attainment, Borel selection and policy optimality; an independent SMT route checks the implication algebra; a compact-action non-Feller kernel with an unattained supremum is rejected.
